'''''Reichardia''''' is a [[genus]] of plants in the tribe [[Cichorieae]] within the family [[Asteraceae]] native to the [[Mediterranean]] and western [[Asia]].<ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Reichardia Altervista Flora Italiana, genere ''Reichardia''] includes photos plus European distribution maps</ref> In [[Crete]], [[Greece]] the leaves and tender shoots of a variety of ''Reichardia picroides'' called ''{{lang|el|galatsida}}'' ({{lang|el|γαλατσίδα}}) are eaten raw, boiled, cooked in steam or browned with [[olive oil]] by the locals.<ref>{{cite book |author= Kleonikos G. Stavridakis, <big>Κλεόνικος Γ. Σταυριδάκης</big>  |title= Wild edible plants of Crete - <big>Η Άγρια βρώσιμη χλωρίδα της Κρήτης</big> |publisher= Rethymnon Crete |year=2006 |isbn=960-631-179-1}}</ref> '''Brighteyes''' is a common name for plants in this genus.<ref>{{PLANTS|id=REICH|taxon=Reichardia|accessdate=19 October 2015}}</ref>
